blocks.text: Kimiyai reaction ke dauran reactants products mein badalte hain, to products ki concentration barhti hai jaise reactants ki girti hai.

blocks.title: Reaction ki raftar (rate)
blocks.text: Reaction ki rate kisi reactant ya product ki concentration mein tabdeeli taqseem us tabdeeli mein laga waqt hai: rate = delta x / delta t, jahan delta x bohat chhote waqt delta t mein concentration ki bohat chhoti tabdeeli hai.

Reactant A ke na-wapas (irreversibly) product B mein badalne ke liye concentration-waqt graph ki dhalwan (slope) shuru mein sab se tez hai, jo reactant mein tez kami aur product mein tez izafa dikhati hai; jaise reaction aage barhti hai dhalwan kam tez hoti hai, reaction waqt ke saath sust hoti hai, aur aakhir mein reaction ke mukammal hone par dono curves mutawazi ho jate hain. To reaction ki rate har lamha badalti hai. Rate ki units concentration taqseem waqt hain, aam taur par mol dm-3 s-1; sust reactions ke liye mol dm-3 min-1 ya mol dm-3 h-1 istemal ho sakti hain, aur gas-phase reactions ke liye molar concentration ki jagah dabao ki units. A se B ke liye rate A ke ghatne ki rate ya B ke barhne ki rate ke taur par likhi ja sakti hai: rate = -delta[A]/delta t = +delta[B]/delta t, manfi nishan reactant ki concentration mein kami aur musbat product mein izafa dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: waqt ke muqable reactant concentration ka girta surkh curve aur product ka barhta neela curve, pehle tez aur phir mutawazi tak hamwar. Daen: Table 7.1 ki saat HI concentrations waqt ke muqable plot ki hui, 100 seconds par nuqtedar tangent aur sabz qaima-zawiya tikon ke saath jo 100 s par 0.04 mol dm-3 deta hai.
blocks.caption: Reactant aur product ke liye waqt ke muqable concentration, aur HI ke tootne ke data par tangent ka tareeqa (Figures 7.1 aur 7.2 aur Table 7.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Reactant curve girta hai aur product curve barhta hai, dono shuru mein sab se tez; reactants kharch hone ke saath un ki dhalwanein ghat-ti hain jab tak curves mukammal hone par barabar na chalein. Kisi bhi lamhe rate wahan curve ki dhalwan hai, jo tangent kheench kar aur tikon mukammal kar ke milti hai: 100 seconds wala tangent taqreeban 160 seconds mein 0.04 mol dm-3 girta hai, rate taqreeban 2.5 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1 (print ise 4 x 10^-4 nikalti hai). Product curve usi waqt wahi qeemat deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Hydrogen aur iodine hydrogen iodide banate hain, H2 + I2 se 2HI. Pehle 100.0 s mein iodine ki concentration 0.010 se 0.0080 mol dm-3 tak girti hai. Is muddat ki ausat rate kya hai?

items: Rate = concentration mein tabdeeli / waqt, mol dm-3 s-1 mein (sust reactions ke liye fi min ya fi h, gases ke liye dabao ki units); rate = -delta[A]/delta t = +delta[B]/delta t.
Concentration-waqt curves shuru mein sab se tez hain aur mukammal hone par mutawazi ho jate hain, to rate musalsal girti hai.
